mapper.sql: select b.batch_id, b.batch_no, b.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, b.style_id, us.style_name, b.material_type, b.material_name, b.vat_no, b.gram_weight, b.fabric_composition, b.color_name, b.width_value, b.inbound_quantity, b.quantity_unit, b.report_no, b.report_file_url, b.inspect_date, b.status, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark from xf_material_batch b left join xf_supplier s on b.supplier_id = s.supplier_id left join xf_uniform_style us on b.style_id = us.style_id
mapper.insert: insert into xf_material_batch( batch_no, supplier_id, style_id, material_type, material_name, vat_no, gram_weight, fabric_composition, color_name, width_value, inbound_quantity, quantity_unit, report_no, report_file_url, inspect_date, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{batchNo}, #{supplierId}, #{styleId}, #{materialType}, #{materialName}, #{vatNo}, #{gramWeight}, #{fabricComposition}, #{colorName}, #{widthValue}, #{inboundQuantity}, #{quantityUnit}, #{reportNo}, #{reportFileUrl}, #{inspectDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
